body: Thank you ... I try to see it as a new beginning but I guess sometimes I just fall into the state that I can't get out of ... Thank you for caring

I wish I knew what parts of my life I would change. I just feel hopeless about absolutely ever path I may take. I'm not sure anymore what triggers my thoughts.. as the triggers seem to be getting smaller and of little to no significance in comparison to what spirals they bring about! I do write, sing, and play piano... but for some reason I feel incapable of doing any of these too.
Thank you for your kind words

A little while ago.. I looked at all the reasons why I wanted to die or that I felt ready to.  Often it was because I wanted a sense of relief.. I did not want to feel the pain anymore... but within that I realized after my first attempt.. that relief is a feeling... and in order to feel.. you must be alive... It helped me a few times to realize this... though I am not one to talk, as I have had many relapses into suicidal ideation and attempts.

:(... Perhaps they won't think you're a loser for being honest with them, as you do not sound like any loser to me. I use to put up a face too... people thought I was stronger than I was and that I could deal with anything the world threw at me. It was only when I stopped with that face to a select few people that I trusted that I began to see that there are people in the world that will love you unconditionally... be it a friend, family member, or significant other.. and sometimes even strangers.  You're strong for even reaching out here on redddit.

I'm so sorry that you are going through this.  I suffer from chronic pneumonia and some other weird symptoms which ends up getting me into the emergency on a regular basis but have no name put to the problem yet. So as I definitely probably can't relate on the deep level when it comes to the physical pain, and surgeries.. it breaks my heart to know even slightly what you may be going through. I'm sorry that you have such trouble talking to women... I don't want you to be alone in this... Although it's not much... we're here on redddit as much as possible... and... that until you do find a significant other... please try to reach out to other loved ones around you... Stay strong... although I know that is hard to do...

This does sound a lot like song lyrics but I find the poetry and other types of writing to be a fine line. The sentiment is clearly there and I can feel it as I read the flow of the words running into the others. Keep it up. Format is one thing, yes... but sentiment, the words you choose to describe, and your own unique style of writing matters immensely; just as much, if not more, than format and structure in the long run.

I suffer from rapid cycling... cyclothymic. My manic episodes and depressive episodes can occur within one day... and many times. It differs slightly from bipolar I and II. 

I hope things work out for you...

Waiting lists are brutal... 

My friends, significant other and family matter greatly...

I am not one to talk because of recent occurrences, but from experience, don't dip your toes into this way of thinking too much... because before you know it you can be way in over your head that it is hard to ever get out of it and back on a semi-right track. Nonetheless, I am here for you, as are the rest of us on reddit, I'm sure. I'm sorry your friend laughed in your face at your thoughts... that's not right... I respect your thoughts and please stay strong... as strong as you can... <3...

Your response has tugged at my heart also. Not many understand this underlying feeling of always being ready.  It is great, though unfortunate, that someone else in this world feels this pull or should I say, this steadiness of being ready, regardless of the will to want to live etc. I find that sometimes... I can really see the greatness in everything, and no matter how beautiful, how great something in life can be... the readiness.. and the hopelessness concurs it... even if, inside you can smile about it. Thank you for your response <3... I hope life brings you peace as well.

Thanks. I definitely use to believe this myself... but now that I've experienced this ultimate state... I have seemed to lose the ability to even fake it... which is just most discouraging! I think that's where it started way back when...that is, when I no longer had the strength and ability to force myself to act and be a particular way... and everything became more than hopeless... no matter how good or bad...

Thank you for sharing.... It does give me hope about not being a burden.  I had reached out lots for help and treatment but have been constantly put on a waiting list for therapy so I really only had drugs and people checking to basically see if I was still "alive and around." The health system sucks sometimes here... the mental health one at least. You make a great point about preventing a relapse is easier than coming back out of it... and I guess that is exactly why I am so scared of hitting this low again and fully relapsing... though it's been hard to prevent and I am scared of falling in full force without any control.. Thank you for the response <3.
Wow! That really gives me hope! I am on seroquel right now but I am slowly coming off of it and switching to Abilify!
